ModDB figures, 21 October 2026. Downloads include files across releases.

A global total conversion of Medieval II: Total War: Kingdoms, covering the political, economic and military upheavals of 1860–1900.

My role: lead developer, historical researcher and media manager. The project combines a worldwide campaign with researched regions, distinct armies, and custom political, economic, social and campaign AI systems.

Released in 2023; finalist in ModDB’s 2023 Mod of the Year awards. Development continues with faction balancing, new campaign systems and historical research.
